## Import the data

```{r}
#dfFull <- read_tsv("2026_March_07_PxW308_F5_RIL_PhenoDatFull.tsv")
dfFull <- read_tsv("~/Documents/2022/IBSpy_Targets/2024-12-05_5B_Yellow_Rust/2025-06-20_ParagonxWATDE_population/2026_Sep_03_PxW308_F5_RIL_PhenoDatFull.txt")

df <- dfFull %>% select(c("PlantID", "Rep", "Tray", "Block", "Plant", "RawScore", "RankScore", "Response"))
```


```{r}
df$Response <- factor(df$Response, levels=c("R","MR","MS","S"))
df$RankScore <- as.numeric(df$RankScore)
```


Still comparing reps but with significance added on th plot
```{r}

##################
# with significance added on plot
#######################

library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)

# One mean score per genotype within each replicate
repMeans <- dfClean %>%
  filter(!is.na(RankScore)) %>%
  mutate(Rep = factor(Rep)) %>%
  group_by(PlantID, Rep) %>%
  summarise(
    RankScore = mean(RankScore),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Retain genotypes present in every replicate
number_reps <- n_distinct(repMeans$Rep)

complete_genotypes <- repMeans %>%
  count(PlantID, name = "number_present") %>%
  filter(number_present == number_reps) %>%
  pull(PlantID)

repMeansPaired <- repMeans %>%
  filter(PlantID %in% complete_genotypes) %>%
  mutate(Rep = droplevels(Rep)) %>%
  arrange(PlantID, Rep)

# Generate all pairwise replicate comparisons
rep_comparisons <- combn(
  levels(repMeansPaired$Rep),
  2,
  simplify = FALSE
)

```

With the mean added to the legend

```{r}
repsComp <- ggplot(dfClean, aes(x = Rep, y = RankScore)) +
  
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "#EBF4FA",
    width = 0.3,
    color = "#16E2F5",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  
  # Individual observations
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = Response),
    width = 0.12,
    height = 0,
    size = 1.8,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  
  # Mean of the genotype means within each replicate
  stat_summary(
    data = repMeansPaired,
    aes(
      x = Rep,
      y = RankScore,
      shape = "Mean"
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 3,
    fill = "black",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  # Paired Wilcoxon comparisons
  stat_compare_means(
    data = repMeansPaired,
    aes(x = Rep, y = RankScore),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    comparisons = rep_comparisons,
    method = "wilcox.test",
    paired = TRUE,
    label = "p.signif",
    hide.ns = FALSE,
    tip.length = 0.01,
    bracket.size = 0.3,
    step.increase = 0.08
  ) +
  
  # Disease-response colours
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Response",
    values = c(
      "R"  = "#1a9641",
      "MR" = "#a6d96a",
      "MS" = "#fdae61",
      "S"  = "#d7191c"
    )
  ) +
  
  # Black diamond legend
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = " ",
    values = c("Mean" = 23)
  ) +
  
  # Add space above the plot for significance brackets
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.25))
  ) +
  
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(order = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(
      order = 2,
      override.aes = list(
        fill = "black",
        color = "black",
        size = 3
      )
    )
  ) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of disease severity scores across replicates",
    subtitle = "Individual plant scores coloured by resistance class",
    x = "Replicate",
    y = "Disease score (ranked)"
  )

# Display plot

repsComp

## save to pdf

ggsave(
  filename = "DiseaseScoresAcrossReplicates.pdf",
  plot = repsComp,
  device = grDevices::cairo_pdf,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  bg = "white"
)

```



By colour

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(RankScore, fill=Response)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth=1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c(
    "R"="#1a9641",
    "MR"="#a6d96a",
    "MS"="#fdae61",

  )) +
  theme_bw() +

```


With the disease response value, 

```{r}
library(dplyr)

geno_means <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(RankScore)) %>%
  group_by(PlantID) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_score = mean(RankScore, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Response = case_when(
      mean_score >= 1 & mean_score <= 2 ~ "R",
      mean_score > 2 & mean_score <= 6 ~ "Intermediate",
      mean_score > 6 ~ "S"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(mean_score)
```


```{r}
table(geno_means$Response)
```

Test chi-square goodness of fit to genetic ratios 1:2:1 and 15:2:15 (F2/3 and at F5) for a single gene segregating

```{r}
obsCombd <- c(R =18, Seg = 30, S =28)

chisq.test(obsCombd, p = c(1,2,1)/4)

chisq.test(obsCombd, p = c(15,2,15)/32)

```

```{r, engine='asis'}
chisq.test(obsCombd, p = c(1,2,1)/4)

	Chi-squared test for given probabilities

data:  obsCombd
X-squared = 6, df = 2, p-value = 0.04979

##########

chisq.test(obsCombd, p = c(15,2,15)/32)

	Chi-squared test for given probabilities

data:  obsCombd
X-squared = 144.58, df = 2, p-value < 2.2e-16

```

```{r}

  group_by(Rep, PlantID, Response) %>%
```

 # check distribution of groups per rep
 
```{r}
table(geno_means$Rep, geno_means$Response)
```
 
 

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
#install.packages("tidytext")
library(tidytext)

## reordering the means within each rep not th whole dataset

ggplot(geno_means,
       aes(
         x = reorder_within(PlantID, mean_score, Rep),
         y = mean_score,
         fill = Response
       )) +

  # resistance zones
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
    ymin = 0, ymax = 2,
    fill = "#1a9641", alpha = 0.08
  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
    ymin = 2, ymax = 6,
    fill = "#fdae61", alpha = 0.08
  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
    ymin = 6, ymax = 10,
    fill = "#d7191c", alpha = 0.08
  ) +

  geom_col(width = 0.8) +

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(2, 6),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40"
  ) +

  # separate panel for each replicate
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Rep,
    scales = "free"
  ) +

  # removes Rep suffix added by reorder_within()
  scale_x_reordered() +

  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw() +

  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10),
    limits = c(0, 10)
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "R" = "#1a9641",
      "Intermediate" = "#fdae61",
      "S" = "#d7191c"
    )
  ) +

  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Ranking of wheat genotypes by mean disease severity score",
    subtitle = "Genotypes ranked independently within each experimental replicate",
    x = "Genotype",
    y = "Mean disease score",
    fill = "Response"
  )
```

```{r}
obsR1 <- c(R =24, Seg = 14, S =34)

## Rep 1
chisq.test(obsR1, p = c(1,2,1)/4)

chisq.test(obsR1, p = c(15,2,15)/32)

## rep 2
```

Now using the individual RIL mean as for the colour of the boxplots 

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidytext)

# Calculate genotype mean within each replicate
# and classify the genotype based on that mean
geno_means_v2 <- dfClean %>%
  group_by(Rep, PlantID) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_score = mean(RankScore, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    MeanResponse = case_when(
      mean_score <= 2 ~ "R",
      mean_score > 2 & mean_score <= 6 ~ "Intermediate",
      mean_score > 6 ~ "S"
    )
  )

# Plot
ggplot(
  geno_means_v2,
  aes(
    x = reorder_within(PlantID, mean_score, Rep),
    y = mean_score,
    fill = MeanResponse
  )
) +

  # Resistance zones
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
    ymin = 0, ymax = 2,
    fill = "#1a9641", alpha = 0.08
  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
    ymin = 2, ymax = 6,
    fill = "#fdae61", alpha = 0.08
  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
    ymin = 6, ymax = 10,
    fill = "#d7191c", alpha = 0.08
  ) +

  geom_col(width = 0.8) +

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(2, 6),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40"
  ) +

  # Rank independently within each replicate
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Rep,
    scales = "free"
  ) +

  scale_x_reordered() +

  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10),
    limits = c(0, 10)
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "R" = "#1a9641",
      "Intermediate" = "#fdae61",
      "S" = "#d7191c"
    )
  ) +

  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw() +

  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Ranking of wheat genotypes by mean disease severity score",
    subtitle = "Response classification based on genotype mean within each replicate",
    x = "Genotype",
    y = "Mean disease score",
    fill = "Genotype response"
  )
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

  )
```

 Spacing them out for better visuals,
 
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Give each RIL a small, consistent horizontal offset
plot_data <- geno_means_v3 %>%
  mutate(
    PlantNumber = factor(
      n_plants,
      levels = 1:5
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(PlantID) %>%
  mutate(
    ril_order = cur_group_id()
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    # small spread around each replicate position
    offset = scales::rescale(
      ril_order,
      to = c(-0.12, 0.12)
    ),
    x_position = as.numeric(factor(Rep)) + offset
  )
```


```{r}
ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(
    x = x_position,
    y = mean_score,
    group = PlantID
  )
) +

  # Connect Rep 1 and Rep 2 for each RIL
  geom_line(
    color = "grey65",
    linewidth = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  # Mean score for each RIL
  geom_point(
    aes(
      color = MeanResponse,
      shape = PlantNumber
    ),
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +

  # Disease-response thresholds
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(2, 6),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40"
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 2),
    labels = c("Rep 1", "Rep 2"),
    limits = c(0.7, 2.3)
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 10),
    breaks = 0:10
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "R" = "#1a9641",
      "Intermediate" = "#fdae61",
      "S" = "#d7191c"
    )
  ) +

  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "1" = 16,  # circle
      "2" = 17,  # triangle
      "3" = 15,  # square
      "4" = 18,  # diamond
      "5" = 8    # star
    )
  ) +

  theme_bw() +

  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "RIL disease scores across experimental replicates",
    subtitle = "Lines connect genotype means between Rep 1 and Rep 2",
    x = "Experimental replicate",
    y = "Mean disease score",
    color = "Mean response",
    shape = "Plants scored"
  )
```
